title: Sharper borrowed eyes: each member's MobileNetV2 trunk is replaced by an ImageNet-pretrained EfficientNet-B0 trunk (stem + all seven MBConv stages, Apache-2.0), read at the same two strides (112x14x14 and 320x7x7 at 224 px)
hypothesis: On this ruler only the quality of the pretrained trunk has moved the held-out truedop_2024 photograph by a large step. From-scratch to MobileNetV3-Small took it from 10.75% to 49.5% usable (exp 12). Reading deeper gave 60.25% (exp 13), MixStyle 65.5% (exp 14), native 224 px input 74.25% (exp 15), and MobileNetV2 86.75% (exp 16, mission 0.155: false fix 2.25%, abstain 11%). Everything since then has been around the trunk and has not moved: exp 18's ring pooling scored 0.158, which is within noise of the champion. The three training photographs are saturated: in exp 16 and 18 bb_dop20, truedop_2022 and truedop_2023 are all 100% usable and 0% false fix at the same held-out viewpoints. So the remaining 0.155 is entirely survey gap, and most of it is abstention: 11% of 2024 frames fall under 0.3 committee confidence, while the confident answers are already 97.5% right (0.8675 of 0.89 coverage). What turns a 2024 abstention into a fix is the place feature landing closer to its prototype despite season, shadow and colour changes. That is the invariance the ImageNet trunk supplies, and it has grown with trunk strength at every step (MNv3-S 67.7% ImageNet top-1, MNv2 71.9%). EfficientNet-B0 is the strongest permissively licensed torchvision trunk that fits the gate: 77.7% top-1, squeeze-excite channel attention, and compound-scaled depth/width trained with heavy RandAugment-style photometric augmentation, i.e. invariances learned under exactly the nuisances that separate surveys. Its stride-16 and stride-32 outputs (112x14x14, 320x7x7 at 224 px) match the two levels the current place feature reads, so no other stage has to change. Size: features[0..7] is about 3.60M parameters, plus about 0.36M per member for lifts, prototypes and offset head, about 7.9M in total. That is about 31.6 MB, roughly 30.1 MiB fp32, against the 32 MiB gate, and BN folding at export lowers it slightly. The same arithmetic predicts exp 16's measured 17.39 MB for MobileNetV2 exactly. This is the trunk-family axis that every gain came from, not a variation of the refuted mechanisms (consistency losses, distillation, blending, decode changes).
method: In model/model.py, each Member's trunk = torchvision efficientnet_b0 features[0..7] (stem + seven MBConv stages; the final 320->1280 1x1 conv features[8] is excluded), with IMAGENET1K_V1 weights loaded strict from a new baked file model/pretrained/effb0_features7.pt. The mid read level moves to after features[5] (112x14x14 at 224 px, stride 16) and the deep level to after features[7] (320x7x7, stride 32). Each level keeps its own 1x1 lift to 56 -> GAP -> concat to the same 112-d feature. MixStyle moves to the stride-equivalent points after features[2], [3] and [4] (24x56x56, 40x28x28, 80x14x14: stride 4/8/16, as before). Everything else is unchanged: the 128->224 in-graph resize, ImageNet normalisation, cosine-prototype head, committee min-mass confidence, pooling, offset, losses, augmentation, LR split (trunk at 0.1x) and epochs.
expected_outcome: Mission 0.155 -> about 0.09-0.12 on truedop_2024, driven mostly by abstentions becoming usable fixes: usable 86.75% -> about 89-92%, abstain 11% -> about 6-9%, false fix flat at about 2-2.5% (the committee's min-mass gate is unchanged and the confident answers are already 97.5% right). Training-capture diagnostics stay at about 0.000 (saturated). Exported fp32 ONNX about 30 MiB (under the 32 MiB gate); host latency proxy about 30-45 ms (under 250 ms). Training wall-clock rises by about 1.3-1.8x versus exp 16 because B0 has more FLOPs and SiLU/SE layers. REFUTATION: if 2024 usable does not rise above 87.5% (no change beyond the exp 16/18 noise band of about 0.5 pt), trunk strength in the ImageNet family has saturated as a lever. The next move is then the training data or signal (e.g. continuous-vantage or geometric jitter, or a cross-survey objective on the strong trunk), not a still bigger trunk.
init_strategy: pretrained:efficientnet_b0 IMAGENET1K_V1 features[0..7] (torchvision, Apache-2.0 weights / BSD-3 code), fine-tuned at 0.1x LR
eli5: The model recognises Berlin through a pair of borrowed eyes: image-recognition networks first trained on a million everyday photos, then taught the city. Every time we gave it better eyes, it got better at recognising Berlin in a photograph it had never seen. This experiment swaps in EfficientNet-B0, the sharpest pair that still fits the drone's memory budget. It was trained to recognise things regardless of lighting and colour, and that is exactly what differs between two surveys of the same street.

stages.name: Camera frame
stages.detail: 128×128 px daytime crop, Berlin only; trained on three survey photographs, scored on a fourth it never saw

stages.name: Feature extractor
stages.detail: NEW: the borrowed eyes are upgraded again. The 128 px frame is enlarged to 224 px as before, then read by two independent copies of EfficientNet-B0 (all seven stages, pre-trained on ImageNet, open Apache-2.0 licence) instead of MobileNetV2, fine-tuned on Berlin at a tenth of the usual learning rate. EfficientNet weighs which channels matter for each image (squeeze-and-excite) and was trained under heavy colour and lighting changes. Each copy reads the frame at the same two depths as before: a 112-channel 14×14 map (textures and local shapes) and a 320-channel 7×7 map (how roads, roofs and trees are arranged across the frame). Each depth is lifted to 56 numbers and averaged over the frame; together they form the 112-number description of the place

stages.name: Map-cell classifier
stages.detail: each extractor's description is centred, scaled to unit length and compared by angle against one unit-length reference direction per map tile (~3,000 tiles, 128 m each) - a compass, not a lookup table; the angle match times a fixed sharpness (30) is the tile score. The two members' tile-belief maps are averaged to pick the tile

stages.name: Local belief pooling
stages.detail: gathers the averaged belief spread over the winning tile AND its 8 neighbours, and places the fix at the balance point of that local cluster instead of snapping to one tile's centre

stages.name: Within-cell offset
stages.detail: small head per member that nudges the fix from the pooled balance point to the exact spot; the two nudges are averaged

stages.name: Confidence gate
stages.detail: confidence = the SMALLER of the two members' belief on the winning tile plus its 8 neighbours — both navigators must independently back the same place; if either one spreads its belief elsewhere the drone abstains

stages.name: Training signal
stages.detail: unchanged from experiment 16: cross-survey style mixing inside the feature extractor (now after EfficientNet-B0's 2nd, 3rd and 4th stages, the same image scales as before; training only), angular-margin tile loss, offset loss, paired three-survey batches, re-photographing augmentation, pre-trained blocks at a tenth of the learning rate; targets, epochs and views per epoch unchanged. Training views are enlarged to 224 px exactly as in flight

implementation_brief:
ONE change: the per-member pretrained trunk becomes EfficientNet-B0 features[0..7]. Start from the current champion code (exp 16, commit a4393f8; the working tree model/ is that code; exp 18's ring pooling was reverted and must NOT be reintroduced).

1. BAKE THE WEIGHTS (once, before training). Create model/pretrained/effb0_features7.pt exactly the way mnv2_features17.pt was made: `from torchvision.models import efficientnet_b0, EfficientNet_B0_Weights; m = efficientnet_b0(weights=EfficientNet_B0_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)`, then save `{('features.' + k): v for k, v in m.features[:8].state_dict().items()}` with torch.save. The tensors must be verbatim torchvision tensors, BN running stats included. Nothing may be downloaded at train or inference time: the loader reads only this file. Leave the other .pt files in place, untouched. The file must be tracked alongside the others in model/pretrained/ so the remote (AWS) training path ships it the same way it shipped mnv2_features17.pt; check infra/aws_train.py or the loop's sync if unsure, but do NOT edit frozen files.

2. model/model.py:
   - Import: `from torchvision.models import efficientnet_b0` (replacing mobilenet_v2).
   - Constants: TRUNK_BLOCKS = 8 (features[:8]); TRUNK_MID_BLOCKS = 6 (features[:6] -> 112x14x14 at 224 px, stride 16); TRUNK_MID_CH = 112; TRUNK_OUT_CH = 320 (features[7] -> 320x7x7, stride 32); PRETRAINED_TRUNK_PATH = .../'effb0_features7.pt'; MIXSTYLE_AFTER = (2, 3, 4), i.e. after features[2] (24x56x56, stride 4), features[3] (40x28x28, stride 8) and features[4] (80x14x14, stride 16). Everything else is unchanged: CELL_PX, N_MEMBERS=2, EMBED_DIM=112, LIFT_DIM=56, INPUT_PX=224, TRUNK_LR_MULT=0.1, COS_SCALE=30, COS_MARGIN=0.25 and the MixStyle p/alpha/eps.
   - build_pretrained_trunk(): `trunk = efficientnet_b0(weights=None).features[:TRUNK_BLOCKS]`, then load strict from the baked file, stripping the 'features.' prefix as now. Keep torchvision's default stochastic_depth_prob (0.2): it is part of how B0 was trained, it is active only in train mode, and it is identity in eval/export. Replace the BN-channel asserts with a shape check that fails loudly: run a torch.no_grad() forward of a zeros(1,3,224,224) through the slices in eval mode and assert the output after features[TRUNK_MID_BLOCKS-1] is [1,112,14,14] and the final output is [1,320,7,7]. Restore the trunk's train/eval state afterwards, or run the check before returning, while it is still freshly built.
   - Member.embed(): the loop structure is unchanged (iterate self.trunk, apply self.mixstyle when i in MIXSTYLE_AFTER, take h_mid when i == TRUNK_MID_BLOCKS - 1). Only the constants change. Iterating features[:8] yields stage Sequentials, which is correct.
   - Member.__init__: the lift_mid input channel count is TRUNK_MID_CH (112) via the constant; lift_deep stays at 320. No other change.
   - Update the module docstring: add an 'EFFICIENTNET-B0 TRUNK (capture-holdout era, experiment 19)' paragraph after the MobileNetV2 one (same style), and fix the Member/build_pretrained_trunk docstrings and comments that name MobileNetV2 or its block indices.
   - CellLocNet, forward(), block_mask, loss_fn, export_onnx and estimate_position are UNCHANGED.

3. model/train.py: keep the imports in sync with model.py, and make sure every name the log lines and return dict use is imported (exp 17 died on exactly this kind of NameError). Update the trunk print line, the 'init' string ('pretrained:efficientnet_b0 IMAGENET1K_V1 features[0..7] (torchvision, Apache-2.0 weights), fine-tuned at 0.1x LR'), the 'capture_sampling' and 'trunk' description strings (112->56 (14x14) + 320->56 (7x7), MixStyle after stages 2/3/4) and the docstring (add an experiment-19 note). The training loop, optimiser groups (trunk_parameters/head_parameters split, assert unchanged), LR schedule, augmentation, targets, survey_diag, CHUNK_SIZE and BATCH_SIZE are UNCHANGED. If MPS runs out of memory at BATCH_SIZE 64, do NOT change the batch size silently; report it. Training reads only buckets(meta, 'train'); nothing under model/ may open the truedop_2024 capture in any form.

4. Pre-flight checks, required before exiting:
   (a) `python -c` build_model on Berlin's meta, export an UNTRAINED model with export_onnx, and print the ONNX file size. It MUST be <= 32*1024*1024 bytes (pipeline/score.py MODEL_MAX_BYTES). The estimate is about 31.6 MB (about 30.1 MiB). If it is over, stop and report; do not shrink anything on your own.
   (b) Run the exported ONNX in onnxruntime on a zeros 1x3x128x128 input and confirm the output shape is [1,3], with u, v in [0,1] and conf in [0,1].
   (c) Run `python -m model.train --area berlin --out-dir <tmp> --epochs 1` with whatever smoke-sized option exists (or a few chunks via max_chunks in a throwaway script), to prove no NameError or shape error in training, survey_diag or export.
   Delete the temporary outputs afterwards.

FIXED CONTRACTS (the frozen scorer depends on them):
- train.py CLI is unchanged: `python -m model.train --area <area> --out-dir <dir> [--epochs N] ...`, with the same arguments and defaults. It writes exactly one ONNX at <out-dir>/models/<area>.onnx and returns/prints the same metadata dict keys.
- ONNX export contract (model/model.py docstring): input 'frame' float32 1x3x128x128 in [0,1]; output 'uvc' [[u, v, conf]], u/v normalised map coords in [0,1], conf in [0,1]; opset 17, dynamo=False. The whole decode stays inside the graph, and ImageNet normalisation and the 128->224 resize stay in-graph.
- Deployment gates: fp32 ONNX <= 32 MiB, host latency proxy <= 250 ms.
- Do not edit any file listed in /FROZEN (pipeline/, score.py, etc.).
